title: User-Selectable Item Sorting, Smarter Filters, Editable Items, Permissioned Collaboration, Reactions, and Reorderable Pins
summary: Users can sort items by Name or Subcategory.
Filter subcategories show only subcategories currently used by items in that list.
Item subcategory pickers still show the full category subcategory catalog.
All filters and dropdown-style option lists are alphabetically sorted.
Existing edit mode is preserved and extended to allow editing item text and subcategory.
Collaborators move to a permission-based model.
Each user can pin lists, drag to reorder pinned lists, and persist that order.
Each user can like/dislike any list; ranking is maintained for all lists and used for public ordering and future search relevance.

item_sort_modes.name: Sort by text ascending, then subCategory ascending, then _id.
item_sort_modes.subcategory: Sort by subCategory ascending, then text ascending, then _id.

finalized_decisions.filter_subcategories: Only subcategories actually used by current list items are shown in filters.
finalized_decisions.item_subcategory_picker: Shows the full category subcategory catalog.

permission_rules.all_collaborators: Can always maintain their own completion state.
permission_rules.EDIT_ALL: Can edit item metadata, enter edit mode, invite collaborators, and update collaborator permissions.
permission_rules.owner_only: Only owners can remove collaborators. Owners always have full access.

reactions.scope: Allowed on all lists, public and private.

ranking.public_lists_primary_usage: Discovery ordering and future search result ranking.
ranking.owner_baseline_score: Based on owner activity: lists owned + lists collaborated.
ranking.voter_weight: Based on voter activity: lists owned + lists collaborated.
continuity: If private becomes public, existing ranking remains and owner baseline applies even with no reactions.
If public becomes private, likes and dislikes remain stored.

frontend: Add item sort control with Name and Subcategory modes.
Persist item sort mode in user preferences.
Split subcategory sources into filterSubCategories and availableSubCategories.
Alphabetically sort filter options, dropdowns, collaborator lists, and suggestion lists using a shared helper.
Extend edit mode to support item text and subcategory editing.
Add collaborator permission controls in edit mode for owners and EDIT_ALL users.
Add pin/unpin UI, pinned-only toggle, drag handle, and persistent pinned ordering.
Add like/dislike controls at bottom-right of list cards.
Render pinned lists before non-pinned lists.
backend: Change List.collaborators from uid strings to structured objects with permissions.
Add normalization for legacy collaborator arrays to default READ.
Add PATCH /items/:id for text and subCategory updates.
Add PUT /lists/:id/collaborators/:collabUid for permission updates.
Extend invite flow to accept optional permissions.
Allow EDIT_ALL users to invite collaborators and update collaborator permissions.
Restrict collaborator removal to owners only.
Add ListReaction model with unique index on (listId, uid).
Add PUT /lists/:id/reaction endpoint.
Extend preferences with itemSortMode, pinnedListIds, pinnedListOrder, and showPinnedOnly.
Return likesCount, dislikesCount, reactionScore, ownerBaselineScore, rankingScore, and currentUserReaction in list responses.
data_model: UserPreference gains itemSortMode, pinnedListIds, pinnedListOrder, and showPinnedOnly.
New ListReaction collection stores per-user reactions.

list_page_order: Pinned lists first, ordered by pinnedListOrder.
Non-pinned public-only lists sorted by rankingScore descending.

frontend: Switching item sort mode changes ordering correctly.
Sort mode persists per logged-in user.
Filter subcategories include only subcategories currently used by list items.
Add-item and edit-item subcategory pickers still show full category subcategory list.
All dropdown/filter options are alphabetically sorted.
Edit mode allows item text/subcategory edits and preserves cancel behavior.
READ collaborator can only view and maintain own progress.
ADD_REMOVE collaborator can add/remove items and maintain own progress.
EDIT_ALL collaborator can edit items, invite collaborators, update permissions, and maintain own progress.
Only owner can remove collaborators.
Pinned lists can be reordered by drag and persist after reload.
Like/dislike controls render in the bottom-right and reflect current user state.
backend: Legacy collaborator string arrays normalize to default READ behavior.
All collaborators can toggle their own done state regardless of permissions.
ADD_REMOVE allows item create/delete.
EDIT_ALL allows item metadata edits, invite collaborator, and permission updates.
Only owner can remove collaborators.
PATCH /items/:id updates text and/or subCategory and upserts new subcategories into category catalog.
Reaction endpoint enforces one active reaction per user per list.
Ranking score includes ownerBaselineScore plus weighted reactionScore.
Reactions and ranking survive public/private flips.
List fetch returns ranking metadata for all lists.
end_to_end: Private list with no reactions becomes public and ranks using owner baseline.
Public/private flips preserve prior likes/dislikes and ranking continuity.
Pinned lists stay first and keep user-defined drag order across sessions.
Search-style ordering can later reuse rankingScore directly for matched public lists.
